newsitem.title: USA: AT&T's NCR debuts mini-cash machine.
newsitem.headline: AT&T's NCR debuts mini-cash machine.

text.p: AT&T Corp's NCR unit said on Thursday it debuted an automatic teller designed for markets other than banks.
The NCR Mini ATM offers a unique combination of convenient size and new revenue generating opportunities for ATM owners, NCR said.

NCR said its customer relationships in the financial and retail markets will help the Mini ATM gain acceptance. Also, the Mini ATM can be linked with store promotions and coupon printing, the company said.

The Mini ATM will include a large color display and a graphics printer that produces retail coupons, prepaid telephone cards and tickets, NCR said. The device measures less than 20-inches wide and 31-inches deep and can be placed on a store table or countertop, NCR said.
The NCR Mini ATM will provide new placement opportunities for gas stations, convenience stores, corporate premises, hotels and fast food restaurants due to its compact size, the company said.
The machine's price will be in the $13,000 to $15,000 price range, a spokeswoman said.
